simple.meaning: שֶׂכֶל (sekel) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “intelligence ; by implication, success.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 16 times across 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, and 4 more, beginning at 1 Samuel 25:3. Its contexts include family, family line, offering, sacrifice, Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׂכֶל (H7922).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שֶׂכֶל (sekel) / H7922 is traced through 1 Samuel 25:3, 1 Chronicles 22:12, 1 Chronicles 26:14, 2 Chronicles 2:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.
May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel; that so you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.
The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because Yahweh loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of Yahweh. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings, and making confession to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
For you have hidden their heart from understanding,
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.
A man shall be commended according to his wisdom,
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it,
The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger.
Don’t speak in the ears of a fool,

Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes; but he will be broken without hand.

definitions.full: H7922. sekel שֶׂ֫כֶל שֵׂ֫כֶל, noun masculine prudence, insight ; — ׳שֵׂ֫ absolute Psa 111:10 +, construct Prov 19:11 +; ׳שֶׂ absolute 1Sam 25:3 +; שָׂ֑כֶל Job 17:4 ; suffix שִׂכְלוֺ Prov 12:8 ; Dan 8:25 ; — 1 prudence, good sense: שׂ ׳טוֺבַת woman of good sense 1Sam 25:3 . 2 insight, understanding: || בִינָה 1Chr 22:12 ; 2Chr 2:11 , compare Job 17:4 ; ׳שׂ טוֺב Prov 3:4 ; 13:15 ; Psa 111:10 ; 2Chr 30:22 ; שׂ ׳אִישׂ Ezra 8:18 ; בְּשׂ ׳יוֺעֵץ 1Chr 26:14 ; שׂ חַיִּים ׳מְקוֺר בְּעָלָיו Prov 16:22 ; restrains from anger 19:11 , wins praise 12:8 , fool despises ׳שׂ מִלִּים 23:9 ; שׂ ׳שׂוֺם Neh 8:8 (|| הֵבִין ) set forth (the) understanding (i.e. the meaning). 3 bad sense , cunning, craft , Dan 8:25 .
